newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shrs close at new 3-yr low on weak prospects.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shrs close at new 3-yr low on weak prospects.

text.p: Shares ended Monday trading at a new three-year low after fears about uncertain market prospects eroded earlier trading gains, brokers said.
The prospects of upcoming labour strife and the sale of additional Korea Telecom shares by the government were both major burdens on the market, they added.
The composite stock index fell 3.94 points to a provisional close of 692.17, the lowest close seen since September 18, 1993, when it ended at 685.94.
"A lot of disappointed selling emerged toward the end of the session because of dashed hopes for market boosting measures from the goverment," said Ha Yong-hyun of Hyundai Securities.

Blue chip shares bore the brunt of the selling. KEPCO, which has been a favourite among foreign investors, declined by four percent, or 1,000 won, to 24,000. Samsung Electronics lost 200 won to 56,000.
Despite the index fall, advancers beat out decliners 442 to 393, with 190 unchanged. Small-caps boosted by mergers and acqusition rumours were among the day's winners.

Miwon Petrochemical rose 700 won to 9,500. Boo Hung Sa gained 680 won to 9,180. "The market is likely to experience further correction without any real government incentives," said Hur Gyung-shik, head of sales at Samsung Securities. "For this week, people see 670-680 as a technically important support line."
The sale of an additional 260 billion won worth of Korea Telecom shares will hurt the already imbalanced supply and demand situation, brokers said.
Loans for margin trading are valued at 2.87 trillion won, while customer deposits trail behind at 2.49 trillion.

Brokers added that possible labour unrest further destabilised the market. Major labour union groups have warned they would stage massive strikes this month to protest the government's labour law reform plan.
The December futures contracts ended down 0.50 of a point to 71.50, while the KOSPI 200 index fell 0.39 of a point to 71.21.
